verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel documents a start-up immigration practice and a J-1 Incubator visa pathway that it runs for university clients. These are legal services and visa routes for founders. They are not accelerator or YC partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing, so they count only as adjacent support. No ecosystem program or startup pricing appears anywhere in the evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents startup-ecosystem programs — YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing
